My main point is everything has a trade-off.

it's not cut and dry that the trade-offs of ZK make optimistic rollups redundant.

Is BSC better than ETH? It's faster/cheaper... but at what cost?

@AndrewMaughan6 @lexfridman @VitalikButerin @ethereum @Bitcoin @dogecoin @elonmusk @ShibainuCoin @IOHK_Charles @Cardano @chainlink @0xPolygon @Truebitprotocol GP ZK may require very complex maths, which could even be more suited to quantum computing... considering rewards flow to first to solve, we could quickly see computing power centralising to a few SC nodes.

After consolidation of power, these could then hold the network hostage.

@AndrewMaughan6 @lexfridman @VitalikButerin @ethereum @Bitcoin @dogecoin @elonmusk @ShibainuCoin @IOHK_Charles @Cardano @chainlink @0xPolygon @Truebitprotocol my point being that *IF* we can solve a general purpose zksnark, then a lot more than just Truebit will be disrupted... its a bit rough to single them out.

@AndrewMaughan6 @lexfridman @VitalikButerin @ethereum @Bitcoin @dogecoin @elonmusk @ShibainuCoin @IOHK_Charles @Cardano @chainlink @0xPolygon @Truebitprotocol the significant barrier to entry of zksnarks means it will not be widely used in the short/medium term.

For small/medium sized calculations not requiring next batch finality, optimistic rollups will likely have a permanent future...

@AndrewMaughan6 @lexfridman @VitalikButerin @ethereum @Bitcoin @dogecoin @elonmusk @ShibainuCoin @IOHK_Charles @Cardano @chainlink @0xPolygon @Truebitprotocol i.e. ZK costs more, and not be applicable for small/medium computations where itll cost more to derive proof than to do computation directly on chain.

For larger computations where ZK shines, an efficient general purpose zksnark is not yet really known... this is years away.

@AndrewMaughan6 @lexfridman @VitalikButerin @ethereum @Bitcoin @dogecoin @elonmusk @ShibainuCoin @IOHK_Charles @Cardano @chainlink @0xPolygon @Truebitprotocol yes, the wonders of Zksnarks has been known some time... but for the immediate future (likely 5years+) optimistic roll-up is the future.
